atoms.text: Bonnie now wants to take you to see Scotland’s landscapes. Will you go around the countryside with her?

instruction.text: Bonnie wants to know if you recognise what Scottish landscapes look like. Select the three images of landscapes in Scotland.

feedback.end: Scotland has lots of open natural areas and hills. You'll find plenty of mountains and lakes all over the country!
feedback.wrong: This is a dry area in Africa. Scotland is wetter, so it is much greener.

instruction.text: Bonnie asks if you know the names of landscapes you might see around Scotland. Drag the images to the correct words.

hint.label: Loch
hint.text: A loch is a large lake in Scotland or Ireland. The word loch comes from the Gaelic languages which were once widely spoken in these countries.

instruction.text: Bonnie has marked three famous natural areas in Scotland on her map. Find Ben Nevis on the map to visit it.
This is Ben Nevis. Find the mountain in the image to learn more.

feedback.end: Ben Nevis is the tallest mountain in the UK. It is over 1,300 metres tall!

instruction.text: Find Loch Ness on the map to visit it.
This is Loch Ness. Find the castle ruins in the image to learn more.

text.text: Loch Ness is a large loch close to Inverness. It is said to be home to a mythical creature known as the Loch Ness Monster - or Nessie to her friends!

instruction.text: Find the Isle of Skye on the map to visit it.
This is the Isle of Skye. Find the tall rocks in the image to learn more.

feedback.end: The Isle of Skye is just one of the hundreds of islands in Scotland. These tall rocks are called the Old Man of Storr and were made long ago by a volcano!
